hints.title: Optimal Worker Pairing
hints.text: Pairing the largest workload with the fastest worker minimizes the peak bottleneck.

hints.title: Sorted Alignment
hints.text: Sorting both jobs and workers in ascending order guarantees the optimal one-to-one assignment.

hints.title: Ceiling Division
hints.text: For each pair, the days taken is ceiling division: (job + worker - 1) // worker.

hints.title: Greedy Sorting Implementation

variables: n: number of jobs and workers
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all permutations of workers takes exponential O(n!) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sorting requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes rearrangement inequality and solves with sorting in O(n log n).
